name: Enrai
source:
It has been 30 years since human beings abandoned all conflicts on the Earth and advanced into outer space. With the membership in the Galactic Federation came universal peace. 

Time is year 353 by the space calendar.
It was a sudden event.
An accident that occurred in the deep space on an unknown planet.
We met.
On this star far from the Earth.
Infinitely under the blue sky.
We met.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
人類放下地球上的一切紛爭、邁向宇宙，至今已有30年。加入銀河聯盟後，人類迎來了全面和平。

時值宇宙曆353年。
那是一場突如其來的變故。
一場發生在深空中某顆未知星球上的事故。
我們相遇了。
在這顆遠離地球的星球上。
在無邊無際的藍天之下。
我們相遇了。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
